name: Mensuration
roadmap: Start with 2D areas (sectors, segments) then advance to 3D solids (cylinders, cones, spheres). Master the frustum and composite-solid problems that appear in DSE Section A(2) and Section B.
roadmap_zh: 從二維面積（扇形、弓形）開始，然後進階到三維立體（圓柱、圓錐、球體）。掌握 DSE 甲部(2) 和乙部常見的截頭體和組合立體題目。

learning_modules.title: 2D Mensuration: Sectors & Segments
learning_modules.title_zh: 二維求積法：扇形與弓形

concepts.name: Arc Length & Sector Area

variables_zh.θ: 扇形的角度（以度為單位）

concepts.key_takeaway: Both arc length and sector area are simply the fraction $\frac{\theta}{360^\circ}$ of the full circle's circumference or area. This fraction is the key to all sector problems.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 弧長和扇形面積都只是整圓周長或面積的 $\frac{\theta}{360^\circ}$ 分數。這個分數是所有扇形問題的關鍵。

concepts.name: Area of a Segment
concepts.key_takeaway: A segment is the region between a chord and its arc. Always subtract the triangle from the sector. Remember $\frac{1}{2}r^2 \sin\theta$ for the triangle area.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 弓形是弦與弧之間的區域。總是從扇形中減去三角形。記住三角形面積公式 $\frac{1}{2}r^2 \sin\theta$。

common_traps.description: DSE questions always use degrees. Don't accidentally use radian formulas like $s = r\theta$.
common_traps.description_zh: DSE 題目一律使用角度。不要不小心使用弧度公式如 $s = r\theta$。
common_traps.fix: Always check: if the angle is given in degrees, use $\frac{\theta}{360}$ fraction formulas.
common_traps.fix_zh: 務必檢查：如果角度以度為單位，使用 $\frac{\theta}{360}$ 分數公式。

learning_modules.title: 3D Solids: Volume & Surface Area
learning_modules.title_zh: 三維立體：體積與表面面積

concepts.name: Cylinder
concepts.formula: V = \pi r^2 h \\\\ \text{Total SA} = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi r h
concepts.key_takeaway: The curved surface area of a cylinder is $2\pi rh$ — imagine unrolling the side into a rectangle of width $2\pi r$ and height $h$.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 圓柱的曲面面積是 $2\pi rh$ — 想像把側面展開成寬 $2\pi r$、高 $h$ 的長方形。

concepts.name: Cone
concepts.formula: V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h \\\\ \text{Curved SA} = \pi r l \\\\ l = \sqrt{r^2 + h^2}
concepts.key_takeaway: Cone volume is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the cylinder with the same base and height. The slant height $l$ connects the apex to the circumference — use Pythagoras to find it.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 圓錐體積是同底同高圓柱的 $\frac{1}{3}$。斜面高度 $l$ 連接頂點和底面圓周 — 用勾股定理求它。

concepts.name: Sphere
concepts.key_takeaway: Surface area equals exactly 4 great circles. Volume formula's $\frac{4}{3}$ and the cube of $r$ are the most commonly forgotten details.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 表面面積正好等於 4 個大圓的面積。體積公式中的 $\frac{4}{3}$ 和 $r$ 的立方是最常忘記的細節。

common_traps.trap_zh: 混淆垂直高度和斜面高度
common_traps.description: Volume uses the perpendicular height $h$, but curved surface area of a cone uses the slant height $l$. These are different!
common_traps.description_zh: 體積使用垂直高度 $h$，但圓錐曲面面積使用斜面高度 $l$。它們是不同的！
common_traps.fix: Draw a right triangle inside the cone: $l^2 = r^2 + h^2$. Always check which one the question asks for.
common_traps.fix_zh: 在圓錐內畫一個直角三角形：$l^2 = r^2 + h^2$。務必檢查題目要求的是哪一個。

concepts.name: Frustum (Truncated Cone/Pyramid)
concepts.name_zh: 截頭體（截去頂部的錐體/角錐）
concepts.key_takeaway: A frustum is NOT a separate shape — it's a large cone with a small cone cut off. Use similarity ratios to find the small cone's dimensions.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 截頭體不是一個獨立的形狀 — 它是一個大圓錐減去一個小圓錐。使用相似比來求小圓錐的尺寸。

concepts.name: Ratios of Similar Solids
concepts.key_takeaway: If linear dimensions scale by $k$, areas scale by $k^2$ and volumes by $k^3$. This is one of the most tested concepts in DSE Section A(2).
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 如果線性尺寸按 $k$ 倍縮放，面積按 $k^2$ 倍縮放，體積按 $k^3$ 倍縮放。這是 DSE 甲部(2) 最常考的概念之一。
